title: Bezafibrate, a Pan PPAR agonist, attenuates experimental rheumatoid arthritis via PPAR dependent modulation of inflammatory pathways with emphasis on PPAR gamma activity.
authors: Singh, Alpana; Chaudhary, Rishabh; Agarwal, Vipul; Kumar, Anand; Chaudhary, Divya; Mishra, Vikas
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接筛选PPAR-gamma激动剂并评估其抗关节炎疗效，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为PPAR-配体而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制研究关联甚微。
abstract: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPAR-gamma) plays a key role in immunoregulatory functions, making it a promising target for distinct inflammatory diseases, including rheumatoid arthritis. In the present study, we aimed to identify and evaluate a clinically viable PPAR-gamma agonist with anti-arthritic potential using a structure-based drug repurposing approach. Initially, molecular docking was performed using a panel of fibrate-class compounds (including pemafibrate, bezafibrate, fenofibrate, gemfibrozil, and clofibrate) against the ligand-binding domain of PPAR-gamma (PDB ID: 7WGO). Pemafibrate demonstrated the highest binding affinity; however, it exhibited poor ADMET properties, including predicted hepatotoxicity and poor intestinal absorption. Bezafibrate, on the other hand, demonstrated good binding affinity and a superior ADMET profile, and was therefore selected for further in vivo assessment. In the preclinical phase, bezafibrate (30 mg/kg/day, oral) was evaluated in a collagen-induced arthritis rat model. Disease progression was monitored through body weight analysis and hind paw and knee joint thickness measurements over 5 weeks. Histological examination of joint tissue and serum cytokine profiling (IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, IL-6) were performed to evaluate tissue damage and inflammation. Bezafibrate significantly attenuated arthritic symptoms, preserved joint integrity, and reduced systemic inflammatory markers. RT-qPCR analysis revealed downregulation of pro-inflammatory transcription factors like NF-kappaB and AP-1 in synovial tissues, supporting its underlying mechanism of action. These findings suggest that bezafibrate, selected through integrative computational and pharmacological screening, effectively ameliorates experimental autoimmune arthritis via PPAR-gamma activation. This highlights its promise as a repurposed therapeutic candidate and warrants further investigation.
abstract_zh: 过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPAR-gamma）在免疫调节功能中发挥关键作用，使其成为包括类风湿关节炎在内的多种炎症性疾病的有前景的治疗靶点。在本研究中，我们旨在通过基于结构的药物重定位方法，识别并评估一种具有抗关节炎潜力的临床可行PPAR-gamma激动剂。首先，使用一组贝特类化合物（包括培马贝特、苯扎贝特、非诺贝特、吉非罗齐和氯贝特）对PPAR-gamma的配体结合域（PDB ID: 7WGO）进行分子对接。培马贝特显示出最高的结合亲和力；然而，其ADMET性质较差，包括预测的肝毒性和较差的肠道吸收。相比之下，苯扎贝特表现出良好的结合亲和力和优越的ADMET特性，因此被选用于进一步的体内评估。在临床前阶段，在胶原诱导的关节炎大鼠模型中评估了苯扎贝特（30 mg/kg/天，口服）。通过体重分析以及后爪和膝关节厚度测量，在5周内监测疾病进展。对关节组织进行组织学检查，并进行血清细胞因子谱分析（IL-1beta、TNF-alpha、IL-6），以评估组织损伤和炎症。苯扎贝特显著减轻了关节炎症状，保持了关节完整性，并降低了全身性炎症标志物。RT-qPCR分析显示，滑膜组织中促炎转录因子如NF-kappaB和AP-1的表达下调，支持了其潜在的作用机制。这些发现表明，通过整合计算和药理学筛选选出的苯扎贝特，通过PPAR-gamma激活有效改善实验性自身免疫性关节炎。这突显了其作为重定位治疗候选药物的前景，并值得进一步研究。
